==About==

Crafting {{i|Cornmeal Flatbread}} will make an {{i|Unbaked Cornmeal Flatbread}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a Cornmeal Flatbread. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead.
